sections.voiceover: The 99th Battle of the Ravine is a historic college football rivalry between two Arkansas universities.
On November 14, 2026, Ouachita Baptist University walks across U.S. Will the 25th-ranked Ouachita Baptist Tigers maintain their narrow lead over the Henderson State Reddies?
Ouachita Baptist holds a 47-45-6 lead, but both teams enter this game with identical 8-2 records.

Fans will pack Carpenter-Haygood Stadium at GeoSurfaces Field to witness this intense, long-standing football tradition. This 99th edition determines which university gains ground in the historic Battle of the Ravine series.
The 99th Battle of the Ravine starts this Saturday.
